name: First V.
role: DevOps Engineer at RareJob Philippines, Inc.
text: He gives his team motivation and advice with the projects assigned to make better results. Highly skilled with both technical and management skills. Great helper, even he managed multiple teams.

name: Elyssa Dienice A.
role: QA Team Supervisor at RareJob Philippines, Inc.
text:
Sir Aaron were able to paved way for us supervisors and maintained relationship as mentor as well as a strict leader whenever needed.

He ensured people are promoted, and paid for the value they give in the company.

He has good work ethics and is able to motivate his peers and people around him to work better and smarter.

Working with him means that someone has got my back through ups and downs.

name: David M.
role: Manager Business Processes at Asthma Australia Ltd
text: Aaron is a very diligent, thorough and professional IT consultant. He is persistent in everything he does and can always find a solution, particularly to difficult situations, to deliver quality outcomes. He is a great project manager and IT developer with many skills that we have used to deliver on our business requirements. If you are looking for a very experienced IT Project Manager or just need some code developed to meet business requirements or just to work through a solution Aaron is the person you should seek out. He won’t let you down and will deliver a quality result.

name: Jerome S.
role: Developer Team Lead at RAREJOB Philippines, Inc.
text: Aaron has been instrumental in our company's adoption of new technologies while simultaneously being our mentor. During our technology transition period, he made sure his knowledge and skills will be able to support the development team while in turn trusting us to deliver quality output. He is the bridge between our off-shore counterparts initiating the AWS migration and our development and devops teams ensuring the success of the project. Post-transition, he directed us towards learning relevant skills for the adoption of the new technology and encouraged us to explore. Whether it's adapting old application and infrastructure or implementing new tools, Aaron will make sure to accomplish it and guide the team through it.

name: Debbie R.
role: Digital and Core System Manager  at Credit Union SA
text: Aaron has been an exceptional asset to our team and a major project we have been supporting. his ability work autonomously, learn quickly on the job, build tools to improve processes,.mentoring a fellow team member is second to none. I would not hesitate to employ Aaron again.

name: Trevor B.
role: Senior Technical Analyst at Aligent Consulting
relationship: Worked in the same team as Aaron
text:
I’ve really enjoyed working with Aaron. His engagement and commitment were outstanding, and he consistently demonstrated a genuine desire to help the team succeed.

He showed strong perseverance when tackling complex challenges, never shying away from difficult problems and always seeing them through.

His positive, can-do attitude had a real impact on the team and played a key role in making projects a success.

I would happily work with him again.
